sourceTextExcerpts.text: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent by his servants to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: 記事は2 Samuel 10:2のナハシュを、サウル時代の王とは区別して同名候補として説明。

occurrenceAudit.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文で名前または関係を確認。
